opportunities.title: APS DLS Student Travel Grant — 2027 Global Physics Summit
opportunities.description: Partial travel support for undergraduate and graduate students attending the Summit.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate or graduate student attending the Summit. Read the linked award terms for any additional conditions.

opportunities.title: APS DCOMP Travel Grant — 2027 Global Physics Summit
opportunities.description: Supports students and postdocs participating in Summit sessions sponsored by the Division of Computational Physics.
opportunities.eligibility: Student or postdoctoral researcher participating in a DCOMP-sponsored session; confirm presentation and application requirements.

opportunities.title: APS GHP Student Travel Grant — 2027 Global Physics Summit
opportunities.description: Travel support for graduate students and postdocs attending the GHP meetings held with the Summit.
opportunities.eligibility: Graduate student or postdoctoral researcher attending the associated GHP meetings. Check the specific award page.

opportunities.title: APS FOEP Physics Outreach Mini-Grants — Fall 2026
opportunities.description: Supports physics outreach activities and resources. The official deadline is November 15, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. ET.
opportunities.eligibility: Must be a member of the APS Forum on Outreach and Engaging the Public within the application window. See the call for project and budget rules.

opportunities.title: ASME Graduate Engineering Scholarships — 2027–28
opportunities.description: ASME lists a December 1, 2026 opening and a March 1, 2027 graduate application deadline. Recommendations are due separately on March 5.
opportunities.eligibility: Graduate students in qualifying mechanical engineering, mechanical engineering technology or related programs. ASME student membership is needed to access the application system. Check the individual scholarship rules.

opportunities.title: IEEE RAS Member Support Program — conference travel
opportunities.description: Travel support for eligible IEEE Robotics and Automation Society members presenting at a participating conference. Check the specific round.
opportunities.eligibility: IEEE RAS membership and a presentation are required. Applicants must also be students or meet the program's developing-country criterion.

opportunities.title: ACM SIGIR Student Travel Grants
opportunities.description: Helps cover registration, lodging and travel to participating SIGIR-sponsored conferences.
opportunities.eligibility: Student membership in ACM SIGIR and either a qualifying presentation as an author or doctoral consortium participation. Check the event's rules and deadline.

opportunities.title: ACM SIGPLAN PAC Student Conference Support
opportunities.description: Travel support for qualifying participation in SIGPLAN-sponsored events. Confirm the event and application process.
opportunities.eligibility: Student ACM member with a SIGPLAN-member adviser. The program lists presenting, coauthoring a paper on the program, or participating in a student poster session as qualifying routes.

opportunities.title: ACM SIGCHI Gary Marsden Travel Awards
opportunities.description: Support for participation in SIGCHI conferences. Check the application timing relative to your conference.
opportunities.eligibility: Check SIGCHI membership, event eligibility and the program's applicant and priority criteria.

opportunities.title: British Ecological Society Small Research Grants — 2027 dates unconfirmed
opportunities.description: Supports research that advances ecological science. The funder says 2027 dates will be confirmed in December.
opportunities.eligibility: Check the official applicant, membership and project criteria before planning a submission.

opportunities.title: NeurIPS 2026 Financial Assistance
opportunities.description: Historical 2026 round. Assistance could include registration or accommodation; the program did not cover travel costs. The cutoff was 23:59 Anywhere on Earth.
opportunities.eligibility: See the official 2026 participation and priority criteria. Do not assume they carry over to other years.

opportunities.title: ACM SIGSOFT CAPS — conference travel and childcare
opportunities.description: Supports participation in SIGSOFT-sponsored events. The organizer publishes travel calls for individual events; childcare is handled separately.
opportunities.eligibility: Students and professionals can consult the applicable conference call. Confirm applicant requirements, accepted work rules and deadlines with the event.

opportunities.title: SIAM CSE27 Travel and Registration Support
opportunities.description: Conference travel support for the 2027 Computational Science and Engineering meeting. The official directory lists this call among open applications.
opportunities.eligibility: Full-time students in good standing or U.S.-based early-career researchers who received a PhD after January 1, 2021. Check the full call and required materials.
opportunities.funder: Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics

opportunities.title: SIAM ACDA27 Travel and Registration Support
opportunities.description: Conference travel support for the 2027 Applied and Computational Discrete Algorithms meeting.
opportunities.eligibility: Full-time students in good standing or U.S.-based early-career researchers who received a PhD after January 1, 2021. Check the full call and required materials.
opportunities.funder: Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics

opportunities.title: SIGSOFT CAPS Travel Support — ICSE 2027
opportunities.description: Partial travel reimbursement for ICSE 2027. The call does not cover conference registration.
opportunities.eligibility: At least one of the call’s categories applies: SIGSOFT member, undergraduate, participant based in a listed low- or lower-middle-income country, or participant who identifies with an underrepresented racial or ethnic group in their work location.

opportunities.title: EGU27 Roland Schlich Travel Support
opportunities.amount: Registration and abstract-fee support; discretionary travel assistance up to €400
opportunities.description: Travel-support requests are due with the abstract by 13:00 CET on December 1, 2026.
opportunities.eligibility: On-site participant who is the contact, first and presenting author. EGU prioritizes early-career scientists and provides limited support for other eligible applicants; see the official rules.

opportunities.title: GSA Graduate Student Research Grants — 2026 round
opportunities.description: Historical round supporting graduate research in geological sciences. No later round is inferred from the 2026 announcement.
opportunities.eligibility: The 2026 call required GSA membership and graduate enrollment in a qualifying earth science program in North or Central America.

opportunities.title: RSNA Medical Student Research Grant — 2027
opportunities.description: Supports a medical student’s research project in imaging. Application deadline: 11:59 p.m. CT.
opportunities.eligibility: Full-time medical students at accredited North American medical schools with RSNA membership in good standing. Check department and project requirements.

opportunities.title: ASTRO Annual Meeting Travel Awards — 2026
opportunities.description: Historical award for early-career abstract authors. No future round inferred.
opportunities.eligibility: Early-career scientists, biologists and physicists submitting abstracts for the 2026 ASTRO meeting. Award application was part of abstract submission.

opportunities.title: AGU Student Travel Grants — 2026 Annual Meeting
opportunities.description: Historical travel and participation support. Check AGU for future rounds.
opportunities.eligibility: AGU student member, enrolled student and first/presenting author. See official abstract and financial requirements.

opportunities.title: ASCO Annual Meeting Merit Awards — 2026
opportunities.description: Historical award supporting selected trainees and students with high-quality abstracts. No future award window inferred.
opportunities.eligibility: See official award criteria and donor restrictions. Award applications were part of abstract submission.

opportunities.title: 2027 ASTRO–AAPM Physics Residents / Postdoctoral Fellows Seed Grant
opportunities.description: Application listed as available by AAPM. Deadline: 11:59 p.m. ET.
opportunities.eligibility: Active AAPM membership, qualifying U.S. residency or fellowship and degree, faculty mentor, and at least 50% protected research time.
opportunities.funder: American Association of Physicists in Medicine

opportunities.title: 2027 AAPM / RSNA Graduate Fellowships
opportunities.description: Application listed as available by AAPM. Deadline: 11:59 p.m. ET.
opportunities.eligibility: AAPM member in good standing in a qualifying CAMPEP program. Check year-of-study and academic criteria.
opportunities.funder: American Association of Physicists in Medicine

opportunities.title: AAPM Expanding Horizons Travel Grant — 2027 Round 1
opportunities.description: Round 1 is closed. AAPM expects to post Round 2 details around February 2, 2027.
opportunities.eligibility: Check official criteria and eligible meetings.
opportunities.funder: American Association of Physicists in Medicine
